data.body: SC-PARAMETER-PIN (sc-3): When implementing this story, pixelmatch MUST be invoked with threshold=0.1 in every Design Fidelity Score computation path. Without pinning the threshold, the same Figma/screenshot pair can produce divergent scores under future code changes, undermining the gate's reproducibility. Add an integration test asserting the threshold value (either via call-arg inspection or a thin wrapper) and demonstrating that a known fixture pair produces a deterministic score across repeated runs. Source: 2026-05-20 preplanning remediation pass against epic 4f8e-a7a6 SC↔DD coverage analysis.
